config.seed_role: development pilot only; no held-out or transfer claim
config.instruction: Pick up the red object and put it in the tray.
config.note: One real inference then one safely retimed absolute target then fresh sensing. Never replay an entire chunk instantly. Stop on cancellation, rejected target, tracking failure, watchdog or safety signal. No classical fallback in learned condition. Independent goal scoring never reaches the acting policy. Separate paid approval required.

sensor_config.seed_role: development observation capture; not a task-success benchmark
sensor_config.instruction: Pick up the red object and put it in the tray.
sensor_config.state_mapping: q1..q7 radians and normalized measured aperture closure, 1-width_m/0.08; follows original DROID training data, not ManiSkill knuckle-angle wrapper

action_contract.units: seven absolute joint angles in radians and normalized gripper closure; original DROID controller projects closure to [0,1] before aperture conversion

limitations: Equal fractional aperture does not reproduce Robotiq geometry on the Panda hand
Experimental camera pose differs from DROID calibration
15 Hz is the dataset rate; ManiSkill evaluates at 30 Hz; safe controller retimes targets explicitly
Checkpoint card omits a weight licence declaration; code Apache-2.0 does not establish weight licence
sensor_config.note: Inference-only. No action dispatch or classical fallback. Paid execution requires separate approval. No claim of a functioning learned motor controller.
